symptom: describe page printed a pluggable widget attribute bound over an association (stored since #2279/#2283 as AttributeRef + IndirectEntityRef) as its final attribute only: `switch swPath (booleanAttribute: System.User.Active)` for `AccountPasswordData_Account/Active`. Re-executing the output was refused (CE7247 guard: not an attribute of the context entity) or, where the final attribute happened to be on the context entity, silently rebound the property without its steps. On Data grid 2 / Gallery properties read by key (configurationAttribute, stateStorageAttr) the binding was left out with an 'omitted' note.
cause: Two describe readers ignored AttributeRef.EntityRef when no SourceVariable was stored: extractExplicitProperties (generic pluggable properties) used describeAttr on the final attribute, and nonDefaultPropsByKey omitted any value with an EntityRef as having 'no spelling'. Behind that, create page itself refused the spelling: an unquoted `key: Assoc/Attr` on a generic key parses as a division (WidgetExpressionV3), and scalarPropertyText / MDL-WIDGET42 refused every expression on an Attribute-typed property except `$Param.Attr` - only the mapped `attribute:` keyword (attributePathV3) and alter page set (#2283's visitor hook) took the path.
fix: Both describe readers print the path through columnAttributeFromRef/associationPathMDL (the formatter Data grid 2 columns and built-in inputs already use). An expression that is exactly `Assoc/.../Attr` (optionally `$currentObject/`-led, segments optionally module-qualified) on an Attribute-typed property is handed to the engine as path text in exec and skipped by MDL-WIDGET42 in check, so #2279's resolver resolves or refuses it.
insight: Fixing only the printer would have produced describe output create page could not parse back: the issue's premise that `booleanAttribute: Order_Customer/Active` is 'the form create page accepts' held only for the mapped `attribute:` keyword. Round-trip tests must re-exec the describe output, not compare it to a string. The Studio Pro-authored PedApp Account_Overview column (System.UserRoles path) already round-tripped (columnAttributeFromRef) and serves as the control. Confirmed on mxbuild 11.16.0: fresh project, describe -> check clean -> exec 'Unchanged page', unit sha1 identical, mx check 0 errors.
test: mdl/executor/pluggable_association_path_describe_2295_test.go (create with association path -> describe -> check -> re-exec: bindings identical, unit bytes identical, second describe identical; controls: plain attribute, PedApp Studio Pro DG2 column; TestAssociationAttributePathText negatives)
